name: Relational Inversion (Phase-to-Resource Mapping)
description: Instead of explicitly defining the three bottleneck groups and listing their constituents (which allows models to directly read the required sums), the description now defines the individual tasks (phases) and lists which hardware resources they require. To calculate the bottleneck sums, the model must invert this relationship—grouping the tasks by their shared resources—to rediscover the three original exclusion sums. This defeats models that rely on extracting explicit aggregation formulas from the text.
